name: enterprise-service-platform
description: Core internal platform for customer billing, appointment scheduling, notifications, and account management

scripts.complexity: eslint 'src/**/*.ts' --format json > artifacts/baseline/complexity-report.json || true && echo 'Complexity report generated at artifacts/baseline/complexity-report.json'
scripts.duplication: jscpd src/ --reporters json --output artifacts/baseline/ && echo 'Duplication report generated at artifacts/baseline/'
scripts.security: npm audit --json > artifacts/baseline/npm-audit.json 2>&1 || true && eslint 'src/**/*.ts' --rule '{"no-eval": "error"}' --format json > artifacts/baseline/security-lint.json 2>&1 || true && echo 'Security reports generated at artifacts/baseline/'
scripts.sonar: docker compose up -d sonarqube && echo 'SonarQube starting at http://localhost:9000'
